block.description: First-pass X-only CoreXY calibration. Move toward X min until the X-min switch trips, then move toward X max until the X-max switch trips, and measure X steps per centimeter from the entered track length.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should run the X calibration routine.

inputs.label: X Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical X travel in cm between the X-min and X-max limit switches.

inputs.label: Y Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical Y travel in cm. Y is not probed; the gantry is assumed parked at Y = this value (Y max) when calibration runs.

inputs.label: Calibration Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric motor speed used while probing X limits.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

inputs.label: Steps per Rotation
inputs.description: Stepper pulse count for one full motor rotation. Use 800 when the driver is configured for 800 steps per rotation.

inputs.label: Max Probe Rotations
inputs.description: Maximum motor rotations allowed for each X limit-switch probe before calibration stops with a safety error.
